reviews.comment: Schubert is a very cool guy but always go off track. The class itself is easy but the exams are very unpredictable. The labs are the hardest part of this class.

Schubert is a great guy, but not the best prof. Lectures didn't correlate to tests. Exam 1 was all oilfield terminology, exam 2 was basic facts learned through the class. There were no quizzes . Only two easy hwks along with an easy online certification. "Hardest" part of this class was the 9 lab reports. Overall not hard at all to get an A.

Midterm consisted of NOTHING that was on Lectures 1-6 of the powerpoint, but the math on the midterm was frustratingly easy. Midterm and Final were 20 multiple choice questions. Final was very easy if you knew what to study, but learning all of his power points would not help much. Great guy, cares about his students. Wish HW lined up w/ exams.

Goes off topic and rarely actually teaches in class, assigns two homeworks throughout the semester that you have to teach yourself how to do, two exams and no final for the lecture, lab is the only challenging part of this class. Easy A otherwise

Dr. Schubert is an interesting & experienced individual, but NOT the best prof. During lecture, he will VERY frequently get sidetracked and tell a story about his experiences in the field. He posts his PPTs so attending isn't necessary. The 2 tests were pretty easy (you get a double sided 8.5x11 cheat sheet). Most of the challenge comes from lab.
